fold: <N> has fallen on hard times, and the debt <N> owes is now the only asset <N> has.
text: Xristos Mosele has fallen on hard times, and the debt Pankratios Mosele owes is now the only asset Xristos Mosele has.
why: Xristos Mosele is the monarch holding the Royal seat over a city of 14,513; 'the only asset Xristos Mosele has' is a debt cannot be so

fold: <N> took <N> in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
text: Quetzal Yam took Moctezuma Hau in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
why: Hau, the guild archmage, apprenticed to a smith for 'the trade, the clients'; another line says Coatlicue Hau taught Hau everything

fold: <N> has asked <N> for a vote against <N>'s own interests.
text: Margarete Braun has asked Ottilia Berger for a vote against Ottilia Berger's own interests.
why: Margarete Braun asks Ottilia Berger for a vote; PEOPLE gives Ottilia no seat on any power or council

fold: <N> and <N> sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
text: Sneha Srinivasan and Ravi Sharma sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
why: Sneha Srinivasan (fortune teller) is said to sit on opposite sides and vote together with Ravi Sharma; PEOPLE gives her no seat on any power

fold: <N> voted against <N> on a small matter last week.
text: Minjung Yamazaki voted against Yong Zhu on a small matter last week.
why: Minjung voted against Yong Zhu, but PEOPLE shows Yong Zhu (apothecary) sits on no council; no shared body for a vote
